title: NIST Dictionary of Algorithms and Data Structures: randomizdrnd
text:
randomized rounding
randomized rounding
(algorithm)
Definition:
A probabilistic method to convert a solution of a
relaxed
problem into an approximate solution to the original problem.
See also
approximation algorithm
,
integer linear program
.
Note:
